GSAP 3.15.0 is vendored from the official GreenSock/GSAP distribution so this static app also works offline.

- Source: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP/tree/3.15.0
- Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

The distribution's license header is retained in gsap.min.js. Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion and page functionality does not depend on GSAP loading successfully.
